title: Russia accuses US of ‘piracy’ in Caribbean over Venezuela blockade
description: Russia's foreign ministry said on Thursday that the United States was reviving piracy and banditry in the Caribbean Sea by blockading Venezuela and said it hoped that U.S. President Donald Trump's pragmatism would help avoid a disaster.

title: Russia Compares US Blockade of Venezuela to Piracy
description: Russia's Foreign Ministry accused the United States of reviving "piracy and banditry" in the Caribbean through its blockade of Venezuela, expressing hope that President Trump's pragmatism would avert a disaster.

title: Russia Condemns US Blockade as Caribbean Piracy Resurges
description: Russia accuses the United States of reviving piracy and lawlessness in the Caribbean Sea by blockading Venezuela. The Russian foreign ministry expresses hope that U.S. President Trump's pragmatism will help prevent a disaster, while affirming support for Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro's efforts to safeguard sovereignty and stability.

title: At UN, Russia and China criticize US conduct toward Venezuela
description: UNITED NATIONS — Russia and China on Tuesday criticized the United States for its military and economic pressure on Venezuela, telling the UN Security Council it was 'cowboy behavior' and 'intimidation.'

title: China Calls on US to Halt Escalatory Actions Against Venezuela - UN Envoy
description: China has urged the United States to heed the call of the international community and cease its escalatory actions toward Venezuela, Chinese Deputy Ambassador to the UN Sun Lei said on Tuesday.

title: Russia, China slam US ‘cowboy behaviour’ over Venezuela at UN Security Council
description: Russia and China accused the United States at the UN of illegal military pressure on Venezuela, as Washington defended its blockade, sanctions and actions against President Nicolas Maduro internationally today.

title: US tells UN it will deprive Venezuela's Maduro, drug cartel of resources
description: UNITED NATIONS, Dec 23 - The United States told the United Nations on Tuesday it will impose and enforce sanctions \"to the maximum extent\" to deprive Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro of resources as Russia warned other Latin American countries could be next. title: Oil? Regime change? What the United States really wants in Venezuela
description: "It's about the division of the world" between the United States and its rivals, Russia and China, says one Venezuelan professor.
